title: my worlds
content: I have 4 very recurring dreams. Ive gotten to where i can explore them and know what im doing in them. I guess lucid? Old victorian house with square door/crawlspace about 2-3 feet off the ground behind hanging clothes in the closet that leads to a round room where the walls are packes with books. Theres a round persain carpet with a chair and a table sitting there. I remember nothing else about this space. My mother has dreamt of this exact space before. My favorite, college campus floaty world: A big college campus with lots of curved hallways with railings because you can see down into a common space. The railings are blue. Theres glass elevators and a huge common area/cafeteria. Theres an outdoor circular patio type space surrounded by grass with tables and benches. Theres a concrete bridge overhead nearby. You can see other campua buildings around. In this world i can float or levitate. Not really fly. I can even feel irl how i do it, by focusing massive amounts of thought and energy into the soles of my feet, but obv i cant levitate irl. The feeling is so powerful and i love to just super jump around everywhere. Zombie apocalypse world: It always starts the same but never ends the same. Im in an abandoned house in a back bedroom that is painted a very light yellow/creamy/tan color. I have a mattress up against the door and its mid day, summertime. Im peering out of the window facing a forest with sun pouring in to where i can see the dust in the air. I hear zombies coming and theyre chasing someone. My least favorite, dark factory: Im always being chased in this one. Its a super dark warehouse/factory with a light hanging above here and there that really doesnt light up much of anything. The floor is concrete and the ceilng area has metal rafters(?) There are lots of big metal production machines but theyre not on. Theres never anyone else but me and whoever or whatever is chasing me. Ive had this recurring dream since childhood where a raggedy ann doll uses ro chase me. The chaser is unknown to me now when i have this dream.
